description: Bounded YDS maximum-density interval decomposition with exact cubic-power energy.

source.title: Speed Scaling
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded profile; no book prose or source code copied

input.job_rules: Every job has integer release < deadline; no speed cap is imposed.

output.encoding: [stage_count,energy_numerator,energy_denominator,(left,right,total_work,original_job_mask)*]; speed for a stage is total_work/(right-left)

workspace.meaning: At most four job windows, fixed endpoint sets, interval records, and exact rational energy state.

contract.interval_candidates: Left endpoints are release times of remaining jobs; right endpoints are deadlines of remaining jobs; require left < right and positive contained work.
contract.density: Sum work of jobs with release >= left and deadline <= right, divided by interval duration.
contract.interval_ties: Choose maximum density; ties choose the smallest left endpoint and then smallest right endpoint.
contract.job_order: For each selected interval, process contained jobs in earliest-deadline order and break deadline ties by original job ID.
contract.compression: Remove contained jobs and map each remaining time t to t when t <= left, left when left < t < right, and t-(right-left) when t >= right.
contract.energy: For a selected interval with work W and duration D, speed is the exact rational W/D and cubic-power energy is W^3/D^2; sum and reduce the exact rational total.
